original_test_intent: Downgrade the intended GPU to an exact approved older VBIOS and prove forced programming, activation, expected version regression and post-downgrade health with a recovery path.
original_method: Bind target 0 to stable identity, verify signed older image and approved downgrade path/security exception, back up current ROM, preflight stable power and forward-recovery image, execute vendor-confirmed forced program once, activate, then validate old version, compatibility, links, driver/ROCm and logs.
manual_activity: GPU firmware/security owner approves older image, force/downgrade exception, target and forward recovery, supervises flash and decides verdict.
required_inputs: Current ROM backup plus known-good forward-recovery image
safety_requirements: Double-check target/image compatibility and version direction
Back up current ROM and prove forward recovery before force write
Stable redundant power; never interrupt or auto retry
After activation stop/recover on version, identity, link, driver, security or health anomaly
agent_execution_scope: Validate immutable inputs and downgrade approval
Execute one authorized forced downgrade and capture progress
Verify/report without choosing image, bypassing policy or retrying

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic `-f` is not the source `-fp 0` and lacks vendor-confirmed forced downgrade semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Only after explicit downgrade approval execute the vendor-confirmed equivalent of `./amdvbflash -fp 0 <approved-older-image>` once, then activate and validate compatibility.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS boot, force/program form and index 0 are retained subject to stable identity and vendor approval.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a downgrade manifest binding current/old/forward-recovery ROMs, tool, stable target and security exception with preflight interlock and post-activation compatibility checks.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds rollback-specific policy, forward recovery and regression evidence to the destructive source command.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Upgrade or same-version reflash does not satisfy older-version behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Successful programming can still expose older firmware defects or revoked security state after activation.

project_override_considerations: Firmware/security owners define allowed downgrade floor, anti-rollback exception, exact older image and forward-recovery procedure.
expected_evidence: Signed tool/old-image hashes, support/security approval and downgrade manifest
Stable target identity/current version/ROM backup hash
Power/OOB/forward-recovery readiness and confirmed exact argv
Activation and exact older VBIOS/ROM identity
GPU count/link/driver/ROCm/security/health logs, recovery dispositions and verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master clearly specifies forced downgrade; DeepSeek's different flag is rejected as non-authoritative.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Older image, vendor procedure and security/recovery approvals can be supplied.

review_improvement: Adds downgrade direction, anti-rollback/security authority and forward recovery to a target-bound flash transaction.
independent_technical_reasoning: A downgrade is not merely another flash: the force path may bypass version protection and reintroduce fixed defects or incompatibility. Recovery should therefore prefer a proven current/newer image and must be ready before programming. Stable physical identity is essential because a forced command against the wrong index can program an otherwise compatible but unintended adapter.
